RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel is not evidence of discrimination on its own. Panel composition is common in medical hierarchies and reflects who holds senior posts, not necessarily how they judged you. Used as your lead argument, it looks like an accusation you can't support and will harden their position.

The stronger facts are substantive: you hold the higher formal qualification plus eight years of documented section leadership, while "broad leadership experience" is vague and unverifiable. And they have ignored a legitimate request for written reasons for two weeks.

Send a firm written follow-up demanding the reasons, with a deadline. Mention the panel composition only as context once you see what criteria they claim to have applied.
